notes: «قالوا جميعا حدثنا شعبة» converges the three branches; «شعبة، عن محمد بن زياد، عن أبي هريرة» is the shared tail
«أبي» (Ubayd Allah's father) is not named in the text, so it is a relation link
«عن النبي» is the saying's speaker and is not a link; «بنحو هذا» is a wording reference and is left out
